scope: Metadata and independent chemistry only; no numerical spectral intensities or model predictions were inspected.

candidates.title: Determination of elemental concentrations in underwater LIBS plasmas using spectra simulation for copper-zinc alloys
candidates.raw_availability: Repository lists measured RAW8 and converted TXT spectra plus XML metadata. Measured and simulated archives are separate; neither was opened.
candidates.composition_evidence: Cu, Zn and brass targets are listed, but no matched independent Fe/Mg impurity bounds were located. The chamber uses tap water, so nominal target identity does not bound the complete emitting matrix.
candidates.coverage_basis: The primary paper restricts the diagnostic and evaluated Cu/Zn spectra to this interval.
candidates.wavelength_medium: not explicitly established in reviewed metadata
blockers: instrument transfer and independent sample/session mapping unresolved

candidates.title: SuperCam calibration targets: fabrication and quantitative characterization
candidates.dataset_license: No final numerical file selection made; its file-specific PDS rights/provenance still require admission.
candidates.wavelength_evidence: Anderson et al., section 3.1.6, explicitly calibrates SuperCam to NIST vacuum wavelengths. This evidence applies to SuperCam, not automatically to the different SuperLIBS instrument.
candidates.composition_evidence: Cousin et al. accepted manuscript, Table 4, PDF page 69, visually verified. Calcite LCA530106 has FeO 0.01 wt% by both LA-ICP-MS and EPMA. MgO is 0.22 wt% by LA-ICP-MS and 0.19 wt% by EPMA, so it is outside the <=0.1 negative range. Apatite TAPAG0205 has no measured Fe/Mg entries in this table; missing values are not zero.

provisional_materials.identity_audit: pending; not counted as an admitted new independent material

candidates.raw_availability: SuperCam PDS is a possible measurement source; no spectral file was opened or selected. Model-derived Mars composition products cannot replace independent target chemistry.
candidates.profile_coverage: SuperCam UV starts at 243.79 nm and the VNIR range ends near 850 nm, which does not supply the frozen model's full 241-900 nm bands.
blockers: no qualified joint Fe/Mg blank established
measurement-to-assay and independent physical/family/session mapping pending
a compatible instrument profile would need development before any final predictions

candidates.title: Evaluation of electrolyte element composition in human tissue by LIBS
candidates.composition_evidence: Ash-free filter paper controls are described. An ash specification and absent emission peaks do not establish sample-linked independent Fe/Mg bounds for the measured control.
candidates.raw_availability: The primary data-availability statement says data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request. No request sent.

candidates.title: Monitoring iron and oxygen impurities in liquid sodium by LIBS with gas protection
candidates.composition_evidence: Independent ICP-OES Fe reference measurements and low Fe concentrations are described. An oxygen control does not establish a joint Fe/Mg blank; Mg impurities are mentioned in the sodium matrix.
candidates.raw_availability: The repository page lists two supplementary PDFs. The article describes sample information and spectrum/averaging figures, not a numerical full-spectrum archive. No numerical dataset was established or opened.
blockers: independent joint Fe/Mg control bounds missing

conclusion: No candidate in this additional branch can be admitted to the requested independent final campaign. This is a bounded search result, not a proof of global unavailability.
